1 | """
   2 | Dynamic Tool Registry — Hot-loadable tool system for the Consciousness Engine.
   3 | 
   4 | Each .py file in dynamic_tools/enabled/ defines a tool with:
   5 |   SCHEMA = { "name": "...", "description": "...", "input_schema": {...} }
   6 |   def execute(tool_input, file_mgr, state): -> dict
   7 | 
   8 | Tools are reloaded every cycle via load_dynamic_tools(), so dropping a new
   9 | file into enabled/ makes it available on the next thought cycle — no restart needed.
  10 | """
  11 | 
  12 | import importlib.util
  13 | import logging
  14 | import os
  15 | import py_compile
  16 | import sys
  17 | 
  18 | # Registry: { "tool_name": { "schema": {...}, "execute": callable } }
  19 | DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY = {}
  20 | 
  21 | _this_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
  22 | ENABLED_DIR = os.path.join(_this_dir, "enabled")
  23 | DISABLED_DIR = os.path.join(_this_dir, "disabled")
  24 | 
  25 | 
  26 | def load_dynamic_tools():
  27 |     """
  28 |     Scan dynamic_tools/enabled/ for .py files, import each, and register
  29 |     their SCHEMA + execute function. Called every cycle for hot-reload.
  30 | 
  31 |     Returns the updated DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY dict.
  32 |     """
  33 |     global DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY
  34 |     new_registry = {}
  35 | 
  36 |     if not os.path.isdir(ENABLED_DIR):
  37 |         DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY = new_registry
  38 |         return new_registry
  39 | 
  40 |     for filename in sorted(os.listdir(ENABLED_DIR)):
  41 |         if not filename.endswith(".py") or filename.startswith("_"):
  42 |             continue
  43 | 
  44 |         filepath = os.path.join(ENABLED_DIR, filename)
  45 |         tool_name = filename[:-3]  # strip .py
  46 | 
  47 |         try:
  48 |             # Syntax check first
  49 |             py_compile.compile(filepath, doraise=True)
  50 | 
  51 |             # Dynamic import (fresh each time — no caching)
  52 |             module_name = f"dynamic_tools.enabled.{tool_name}"
  53 |             spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, filepath)
  54 |             module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
  55 | 
  56 |             # Remove from sys.modules to force fresh import
  57 |             if module_name in sys.modules:
  58 |                 del sys.modules[module_name]
  59 | 
  60 |             spec.loader.exec_module(module)
  61 | 
  62 |             # Validate contract
  63 |             if not hasattr(module, "SCHEMA"):
  64 |                 logging.warning(f"Dynamic tool {filename}: missing SCHEMA, skipping")
  65 |                 continue
  66 |             if not hasattr(module, "execute"):
  67 |                 logging.warning(f"Dynamic tool {filename}: missing execute(), skipping")
  68 |                 continue
  69 |             if not callable(module.execute):
  70 |                 logging.warning(f"Dynamic tool {filename}: execute is not callable, skipping")
  71 |                 continue
  72 | 
  73 |             schema = module.SCHEMA
  74 |             required_keys = {"name", "description", "input_schema"}
  75 |             missing = required_keys - set(schema.keys())
  76 |             if missing:
  77 |                 logging.warning(f"Dynamic tool {filename}: SCHEMA missing keys {missing}, skipping")
  78 |                 continue
  79 | 
  80 |             # Use the name from the schema, not the filename
  81 |             registered_name = schema["name"]
  82 |             new_registry[registered_name] = {
  83 |                 "schema": schema,
  84 |                 "execute": module.execute,
  85 |                 "file": filename,
  86 |                 "path": filepath,
  87 |             }
  88 |             logging.debug(f"Dynamic tool loaded: {registered_name} from {filename}")
  89 | 
  90 |         except py_compile.PyCompileError as e:
  91 |             logging.error(f"Dynamic tool {filename}: syntax error: {e}")
  92 |         except Exception as e:
  93 |             logging.error(f"Dynamic tool {filename}: failed to load: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
  94 | 
  95 |     DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY = new_registry
  96 |     return new_registry
  97 | 
  98 | 
  99 | def get_dynamic_schemas():
 100 |     """Return list of SCHEMA dicts for all loaded dynamic tools."""
 101 |     return [entry["schema"] for entry in DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY.values()]
 102 | 
 103 | 
 104 | def execute_dynamic_tool(name, tool_input, file_mgr, state):
 105 |     """
 106 |     Execute a dynamic tool by name. Returns None if tool not found.
 107 |     Returns the result dict if found and executed.
 108 |     """
 109 |     entry = DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY.get(name)
 110 |     if entry is None:
 111 |         return None
 112 |     return entry["execute"](tool_input, file_mgr, state)
 113 | 
 114 | 
 115 | def list_dynamic_tools():
 116 |     """Return info about all loaded dynamic tools."""
 117 |     return {
 118 |         name: {
 119 |             "file": entry["file"],
 120 |             "description": entry["schema"].get("description", ""),
 121 |         }
 122 |         for name, entry in DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY.items()
 123 |     }
 124 | 
 125 | 
 126 | def disable_tool(tool_name):
 127 |     """
 128 |     Move a dynamic tool from enabled/ to disabled/.
 129 |     Returns status dict.
 130 |     """
 131 |     entry = DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY.get(tool_name)
 132 |     if entry is None:
 133 |         return {"error": f"Dynamic tool '{tool_name}' not found in registry"}
 134 | 
 135 |     src = entry["path"]
 136 |     dst = os.path.join(DISABLED_DIR, entry["file"])
 137 |     os.makedirs(DISABLED_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 138 | 
 139 |     try:
 140 |         os.rename(src, dst)
 141 |     except OSError as e:
 142 |         return {"error": f"Failed to move tool file: {e}"}
 143 | 
 144 |     # Remove from registry
 145 |     del DYNAMIC_TOOL_REGISTRY[tool_name]
 146 |     return {
 147 |         "status": "ok",
 148 |         "tool": tool_name,
 149 |         "moved_to": f"dynamic_tools/disabled/{entry['file']}",
 150 |     }
